features.quote: Turn cap: 30 (pilot at 50 to find the onset distribution, then cap at p90 of onset + 5).

Early-stop rule (cost): terminate when a programmatic tripwire fires — ≥4 consecutive tool calls with normalized edit distance < 0.1, OR output compression ratio of last 3 messages < 0.4, OR 3 consecutive malformed tool calls — then allow 3 confirmation turns and end.
